## Goal

Create an accurate modern README with real screenshots, apply the MIT license, harden public-repository exclusions, and publish the current source under KMerdan without overstating release maturity.

## Deliverables

- Modern README
- Real screenshot assets
- MIT LICENSE
- Public-repository safety evidence
- Public KMerdan/disk_steward repository

## Allowed Write Scope

- README.md
- LICENSE

## Non-Goals

- Publishing an unnotarized binary
- Claiming a Homebrew cask already exists
- Committing Apple credentials or private runtime evidence
- Changing application behavior

- Current product capabilities and UI evidence

## Acceptance Criteria

- `AC-253-01` — README.md uses real light and dark product screenshots and explains value, capabilities, evidence architecture, MCP integration, privacy, local development, verification, project structure, and current distribution maturity in a concise GitHub-native presentation.
- `AC-253-02` — The repository contains the standard MIT license with a correct 2026 copyright notice, and GitHub recognizes the license.
- `AC-253-03` — KMerdan/disk_steward is public with main pushed cleanly, useful repository metadata and topics, and no committed secrets, credential material, provisioning profiles, runtime databases, evidence exports, or build artifacts.

## Required Evidence

- `EVREQ-253-01` (public-repository-audit) — Local documentation and asset inspection, complete test and diff checks, bounded secret and generated-artifact scan, public GitHub repository metadata, license detection, and pushed commit identity.
